pretreatment: RCA cleaning (10 min 1:1:5 solution of 25% NH4OH + 30% H2O2 + H2O at 80 °C, 30 s 1:50 solution of 50% HF + H2O at room temperature, and 15 min 1:1:5 solution of 37% HCl + 30% H2O2 + H2O at 80 °C), and dipped in HF immediately prior to all film depositions (except liquid phase deposition) to remove native oxide from the silicon surface
evidence: Highly conductive n-type silicon wafers of 0.005 –0.018 Ω cm resistivity and (1 1 1) orientation were used as the working electrode substrates. The wafers were initially RCA-cleaned (10 min 1:1:5 solution of 25% NH4OH + 30% H2O2 + H2O at 80 °C, 30 s 1:50 solution of 50% HF + H2O at room temperature, and 15 min 1:1:5 solution of 37% HCl + 30% H2O2 + H2O at 80 °C), and dipped in HF immediately prior to all film depositions (except liquid phase deposition) to remove native oxide from the silicon surface.
